resources.string: A small clock that floats over any app.
Needed to show the clock on top of YouTube, games or any other app.
Shows Show, Hide and Lock buttons in your notification shade.

Android blocks this for apps installed outside the Play Store. One-time fix:
1. Tap Open App info below.
2. Tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings.
3. Confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
4. Come back here and tap Allow again.
No “Allow restricted settings” in the ⋮ menu? Tap Allow above once more, then check again. On some phones it only appears after one blocked try.
Could not show the clock. Check the “Display over other apps” permission.
Pull down Quick Settings, tap the pencil (edit), and drag in “Floating Clock”.
Tip: while unlocked, pinch the clock with two fingers to resize it. Picking a size resets the pinch.
A see-through rounded box behind the time, so it is easy to read on any screen.
Updates every second (uses a little more battery).
Shows the day and date under the time.
Shows how much battery is left.
Taps go straight through the clock to the app below. Turn off to drag it again. While locked, the clock is at most 80% opaque (Android rule for touch-through windows).
After dragging, the clock slides to the nearer side.
Keeps a small silent notification with a Show button, even while the clock is hidden.

• Tap Show the clock, or use the Floating Clock tile in Quick Settings.
• Drag the clock anywhere, or pinch it with two fingers to resize. Position and size are remembered.
• Turn on Lock position so it never gets in the way of taps.
• Hide it from the tile, the notification, or this screen.
• The clock stops updating while the screen is off, to save battery.
Free forever · No ads · No login · No internet
Tap Hide to remove it, or Lock to let taps pass through.
Tap Show to float the clock over any app.
